_comment: TOOLS = MCP servers, fed to every agent via the ACP session/new call (NOT a native config file — agents' own formats differ: .mcp.json (JSON) for Claude/Cursor vs ~/.codex/config.toml (TOML) for Codex). ACP is what unifies them. Shape is the de-facto `mcpServers` object (Claude Desktop/Code/Cursor). env values support ${VAR} expansion for API keys.

ddg-search._comment: Keyless web search (DuckDuckGo). Exposes the `search` and `fetch_content` tools to every agent — the universal floor so even harnesses with no native web search can honor 'Search first'. Paired with the web-search SKILL (config/skills/web-search). Needs uvx on PATH.
